report_name: WhiteArmor Ransomware Claims Breach of Echo Global Logistics

threat_actors.name: WhiteArmor
threat_actors.description: An emerging ransomware group that claimed a major cyberattack against Echo Global Logistics, alleging the theft of millions of records and demanding a $10 million ransom. The group appears to focus on the transportation and supply chain sector, having also targeted Ryder and JB Hunt.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through double extortion ransomware campaigns.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The WhiteArmor group presumably deployed ransomware to encrypt systems at Echo Global Logistics to disrupt operations as part of their double extortion attack.

attack_patterns.name: Transfer Data to Cloud Account
attack_patterns.description: WhiteArmor claimed to have exfiltrated a vast trove of data, including millions of records related to freight, customers, and employees, to use as leverage in their ransom demand.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The initial access vector for the attack is suspected to be compromised employee credentials obtained from infostealer malware logs available in underground markets.

attack_patterns.name: PowerShell
attack_patterns.description: Encoded PowerShell commands were noted as a hunting hint for activity related to this type of attack, frequently used by attackers for reconnaissance and lateral movement after initial access.

malware.name: WhiteArmor Ransomware
malware.description: The ransomware used by the WhiteArmor group to encrypt victim systems and exfiltrate data as part of a double extortion scheme.

tools.name: AdFind
tools.description: Mentioned as a common tool for Active Directory reconnaissance in post-access scenarios similar to the WhiteArmor attack.

identities.name: Echo Global Logistics
identities.description: A major Chicago-based supply chain and logistics company targeted by the WhiteArmor ransomware group, which claimed to have stolen millions of records and demanded a $10 million ransom.

identities.name: Ryder
identities.description: A major logistics firm mentioned as another target of the WhiteArmor group, suggesting a sector-specific focus.

identities.name: JB Hunt
identities.description: A major logistics firm mentioned as another target of the WhiteArmor group, suggesting a sector-specific focus.

infrastructure.name: WhiteArmor Leak Site
infrastructure.description: A dark web leak site where the WhiteArmor group posted its claim of breaching Echo Global Logistics and detailed the allegedly stolen data.

indicators.name: Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
indicators.pattern:
title: Encoded PowerShell Command Execution
id: 2b8a1c9d-4e6f-4a1b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of encoded PowerShell commands, a common technique used by attackers for obfuscation during reconnaissance and lateral movement, as mentioned in the WhiteArmor ransomware analysis.
references:
  - https://qpulse.quasarcybertech.com/news/7435/whitearmor-ransomware-group-claims-data-exfiltration-from-echo-global-logistics
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-29
tags:
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.execution
level: medium
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - ' -enc '
      - ' -encodedcommand '
      - ' -e '
  condition: all of selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of encoded PowerShell commands, a common technique used by attackers for obfuscation during reconnaissance and lateral movement.
